                    /* ToolbarTool exposes pressed/released/canceled (no pressAndHold), so a*/
                    /* hold Timer tells them apart; the grid action moves OFF onPressed to*/
                    /* onReleased so a long hold doesn't ALSO open the grid.*/
                    /* NOTE: a NEW `property` added to this element via qmldiff INSERT does*/
                    /* NOT bind here — on the real device a write to it raises "Invalid write*/
                    /* to global property" and the handler aborts. So we keep NO custom flag*/
                    /* and read the Timer's own `running`: still running on release ⇒ short*/
                    /* tap (the 500ms hold hadn't fired) ⇒ open the grid; not running ⇒ the*/
